rationale: The single finding from the initial review is resolved. CR-001 fixed: added two test cases with saturated mid-luminance navigation backgrounds verifying the WCAG AA contrast guarantee holds beyond pure black/white.

findings.title: Missing test coverage for saturated nav backgrounds
findings.resolution: Added two test cases with saturated mid-luminance navigation backgrounds (#7c3aed violet, #1e40af dark-blue) verifying contrastRatio(text, surface) >= 4.5 for the bottom-navigation-label hover surface. No changes to rules.ts or colorUtils.ts.
